latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor Maker Generator — AI-powered cloud video editor.

- Instantly edit and export videos by uploading footage and describing your needs in plain language.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; exports in 1080p MP4 by default.
- Automated setup connects to a cloud backend, checking for necessary tokens and configuring sessions.
- Handles upload, editing, status, and export workflows with real-time feedback.
- Guides users through error handling (e.g., token issues, file limits) and displays clear progress updates.
